name: Pulse
subtitle: An offline-first companion for your WHOOP strap.
description: Pulse is an independent iPhone companion for a WHOOP strap you own. Strap metrics are computed and stored on-device. An optional Pulse account enables cloud backup and recovery; recording and scoring work without an account. Choose account protection without a separate key, or recovery-key encryption. Optional integrations may contact services you configure. Pulse is not affiliated with WHOOP. Source: https://github.com/jmlcoliveira/noop

versions.localizedDescription: Heart-rate Live Activities now run only during workouts started in Pulse and end when the workout finishes or is discarded. Adding password sign-in after Google confirmation preserves verified email status without an extra verification email. Updated settings and account setup messages.

Fixes Google sign-in after reinstalling. New cloud backups preserve the exact birth date, portable app settings and selected background photo. Choose account protection without a separate recovery code (the backup service can read these backups), or retain recovery-code encryption. Existing encrypted backups still require their original code. Full stored history remains losslessly compressed.

Optional Google or email/password accounts and encrypted automatic backup for one active iPhone. Lossless compression preserves full recorded history; automatic preparation waits for charging. Recovery-key restore includes validation, rollback and Apple Health replay protection. Recording and scoring remain local. Hosted backup currently requires an invited account.

Pulse branding, heart-rate stability and performance improvements, safer Apple Health workout and calorie sync, and AltStore background-task compatibility. Keep any existing Xcode-installed copy until its history has been migrated and verified.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Pulse reads your strap over Bluetooth and stores readings on this iPhone. If you enable encrypted cloud backup, those readings are included in your private backup.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Pulse reads Apple Health to compute metrics on this iPhone. If you enable encrypted cloud backup, imported records are included in your private backup.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Pulse writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pulse records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. Routes are included in encrypted cloud backups only when you enable them.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pulse uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Pulse reads your iPhone's step count for walking and running workouts to show steps in the activity summary. Recorded steps are included in encrypted cloud backups only when you enable them.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Pulse transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
